priority.name: priority
priority.comment: Priority order for document ranking in RAG

defered_language.name: defered_language
defered_language.comment: Language to switch to when user not use primary language (e.g english)

welcome_message.name: welcome_message
welcome_message.comment: Welcome message sent to users when they start a chat

fallback_message.name: fallback_message
fallback_message.comment: Fallback message when the bot cannot answer

parent_folder_id.name: parent_folder_id
parent_folder_id.comment: Parent folder for tree structure hierarchy

title.name: title
title.comment: Title/name of the knowledge item. For FILE: filename, URL: page title, TEXT: content title

content.name: content
content.comment: Content storage. For FILE: extracted text, URL: URL string, TEXT: raw text content

metadata.name: metadata
metadata.comment: Type-specific metadata: FILE={fileName, mimeType}, URL={url, processingMethod, crawlDepth}, TEXT={sourceLink}

error_message.name: error_message
error_message.comment: Error details if status is FAILED

chunk_index.name: chunk_index
chunk_index.comment: Zero-based position of this chunk within the parent item

page_index.name: page_index
page_index.comment: Source page number for FILE/PDF items (null for TEXT/URL)

url.name: url
url.comment: Source URL for URL items or individual crawled pages

tag.name: tag
tag.comment: Tag name for flexible item categorization

amount.name: amount
amount.comment: Amount of usage (bytes for storage, tokens for AI, etc)

source.name: source
source.comment: Source of usage: KNOWLEDGE_BASE, CHATBOT, AI_PROCESSING
